name: Duke 556 Assault Rifle
summary: Military-grade tactical assault rifle manufactured by Duke Arms Company, chambered in 5.56x45mm with selective fire capabilities.
description: The Duke 556 is the premier combat assault rifle in Grand Theft Auto VI, modeled closely after the modern AR-15 / M4A1 weapon platform. Featuring a 30-round STANAG magazine, Picatinny accessory rails for optics and tactical flashlights, and exceptional intermediate-range accuracy, the Duke 556 is favored by law enforcement tactical response units and professional heist operators.
